mission_10: Masterful! You have completed the Neuro-Symbolic AI chapter by implementing a Neuro-Symbolic NLP system that unifies neural text representations with symbolic linguistic knowledge. Your system learns word embeddings through contrastive training, encodes sentences via averaged embeddings with nonlinear projection, maintains a symbolic knowledge base of word relationships, and computes combined similarity that blends neural and symbolic signals. This architecture demonstrates the power of neuro-symbolic AI: neural components handle the statistical learning from data, while symbolic components provide explicit knowledge that improves generalization, handles rare cases, and provides interpretable reasoning. From logic neurons to hybrid reasoning to neuro-symbolic NLP, you now possess a comprehensive toolkit for building AI systems that both learn and reason.
